annotations.title: Search Hacker News 'Who Is Hiring' Startup Leads

description: Extract structured startup hiring leads from official monthly 'Ask HN: Who is hiring?' threads via Algolia HN API—with company domain, remote/hybrid/onsite flags, visa sponsorship, salary bands, tech stack, and contact emails (`corridordata/hn-whos-hiring-startup-leads`).

keywords.description: Optional tech stack or role keywords (e.g. ['Rust', 'TypeScript', 'LLM']).

maxItems.description: Maximum startup hiring posts to return.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Optional per-run USD spend cap forwarded to Apify Pay-Per-Event billing (`maxTotalChargeUsd`).

monthsBack.description: Number of recent monthly HN hiring threads to scan.

remoteOnly.description: Return only startups offering remote roles.

visaSponsorshipOnly.description: Return only startups mentioning visa sponsorship.

name: search_hn_hiring_startups
